ballots.name: Noor
ballots.reason: Version 1 permits autonomous work with unchanged agent grants and no specified resource or isolation limits; separate checkouts and owner-controlled installation do not bound development-time risks.

ballots.name: Jonas
ballots.reason: I favor scoped owner-delegated maintenance authority with resource limits and bounded concurrent work, not general permission to initiate candidate releases.

ballots.name: Lena
ballots.reason: The motion lacks any concurrency cap or consolidation requirement, leaving the owner's review queue unbounded and their attention cost unprotected against a flood of unsolicited candidates.
